paper.title_en: Gravitational Lensing of Gravitational Waves: Towards a Higher-order Geometric-optics Approach
paper.abstract_en: In this work, we study the gravitational lensing of gravitational waves (GWs) by extending the geometric-optics approximation to higher order. With the help of the Newman-Penrose formalism, we reexpress the GW propagation equations as a series of scalar equations and present explicit expressions for the Weyl scalars that describe the GW polarizations. By combining the approaches of solving geodesic deviation and transport equations, we construct a solvable system of equations that describes the evolution of GW polarization along null geodesics. This framework fills the gap left by the leading-order geometric optics and the Kirchhoff diffraction integral, neither of which captures the polarization characteristics of GWs during the lensing process. This work applies the above framework to a Schwarzschild lensing configuration. Through a rigorous theoretical formulation and detailed numerical analysis, our results reveal the emergence of apparent vector and scalar modes in lensed GW signals, which originate from the smearing of the polarization plane and distortion of the wavefront and do not represent genuine dynamical degrees of freedom but rather arise as the propagation effects imposed by gravitational lensing.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文扩展了几何光学近似到高阶，结合Newman-Penrose形式主义与测地偏离方法，系统研究了引力波在透镜过程中的偏振演化，理论推导严谨，数值分析详细，属于引力波透镜领域的实质性进展，适合推荐阅读。
decision.title_zh: 引力波的引力透镜效应：走向高阶几何光学方法
decision.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们通过将几何光学近似扩展到更高阶来研究引力波（GWs）的引力透镜效应。借助Newman-Penrose形式主义，我们将GW传播方程重新表述为一组标量方程，并给出了描述GW偏振的Weyl标量的显式表达式。通过结合求解测地偏离和输运方程的方法，我们构建了一个可解的方程组，描述了GW偏振沿零测地线的演化。该框架填补了前导阶几何光学和Kirchhoff衍射积分留下的空白，两者均未捕获透镜过程中GW的偏振特性。这项工作将上述框架应用于Schwarzschild透镜配置。通过严格的理论公式和详细的数值分析，我们的结果揭示了透镜化GW信号中出现明显的矢量和标量模式，这源于偏振平面的模糊和波前的畸变，并不代表真实的动力学自由度，而是作为引力透镜施加的传播效应出现。
